summary: Documentation only, no code, configuration or workflow change: proposes ADR-0145 (status proposed) for TM-10's 'consider fact review before shared facts are recalled' and points TM-10's next action at it; ADR index regenerated. The proposal was reviewed as a design against the current write and read paths: every write into a shared bank (REST retain, gateway retain, automatic retention) goes through memory_outbox.submit when the durable outbox is on; the in-memory queue path (enqueue) exists only without it, so the ADR requires the durable outbox. Holding writes before delivery is the only router point where one writer's text is unmixed; recall-side filters were rejected because consolidated observations lose source metadata (ADR-0059). Reviewers need read on the scope, so seeing held text adds no exposure beyond their grant; approve/reject by anyone else answers 404 so held operations are not revealed; approval re-checks grants (removed writer -> revoked); rejected and expired payloads are scrubbed; the control UI keeps showing counts only (content in the admin UI deferred to its own ADR, B2/TM-03). Finding fixed in the proposal before publication: held operations count against outbox_capacity while outbox_client_capacity is off by default, so one writer could fill the global outbox with held writes for the whole expiry and block all clients' memory writes (TM-08); the ADR now bounds held operations per writer and scope (review_max_held, refusal only for that writer) and lists the rejected-case test. Also added: replay of a rejected event stays rejected; the review tool reads its credential from the environment; direct backend access bypasses review as it bypasses every grant (B5, TM-11).
limitations: The ADR is a proposal; nothing is implemented, so no behaviour was tested. Its confirmation section lists the rejected-case tests the implementing pull request must bring.
The design was checked against the current code paths, not against a running Hindsight or a real reviewer workflow.
The end-to-end suite was not run: no router or agent code changed.
